items.section: Introductory Material
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Напита̀ Гдⷭ҇ь Оу҆ченикѝ своя̀ бра́шномъ нб҃нымъ, пре́жде стра́сти даетъ и҆̀мъ хлѣ́бъ а҆́гглскій па́че ма́нны пре́дивныя: Ѻ҆тцы̀ ва́ши, речѐ Гдⷭ҇ь, ядо́ша ма́ннꙊ въ пꙊсты́ни и҆ оу҆мро́ша, се́й е́сть Хлѣ́бъ сходя́й с нб҃сѐ, а҆́ще кто̀ ѿ него̀ я́стъ не оу҆́мретъ, но жи́въ бꙊ́детъ въ вѣ́ки: Его́же и҆ на́съ нн҃ѣ сподо́би причасти́тися, мл҃твами Тоя́ ради Бг҃ома́тере.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* The upper room appeared greater than the shadow of old, where Christ celebrated the Passover, both the unbloody supper and the reasonable service; and the table of the perfected Mysteries therein is a spiritual altar.

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.section: Introductory Material
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Прїиди́те пра́зднолюбцы вѣ́рнїи, восплеще́мъ дне́сь мі́рꙊ спаси́тельное торжество̀ живо́тнаго хлѣ́ба, и҆ Бж҃їяго А҆́гнца взе́млющаго грѣхѝ мі́ра и҆ прегрѣше́нїя, не въ ква́сѣ зло́кве́тхїя, но въ безква́сїи чистоты̀ и҆ и҆́стинны, ѡ҆чи́щше оу҆̀бо себѐ досто́йно причасти́мся емꙊ̀, я҆́ко да полꙊчи́мъ вѣ́чнаго Ца́рствїя его̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* The Lord nourished His disciples with heavenly food; before the Passion He gives them the angelic Bread rather than the marvelous manna. Your fathers, said the Lord, ate manna in the wilderness and died; this is the Bread which comes down from heaven: if any man eat of this Bread, he shall not die, but shall live unto ages. Whereof do Thou also make us worthy now to partake, by the prayers of Her that bare Thee, the Mother of God.

provenance.verbatim_source:

Whereof do Thou also make us worthy now to partake, by the prayers of Her that bare Thee, the Mother of God.

items.section: At the Litiya, Stichera. Tone 6
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же еди́нъ и҆мѣ́яй безсме́ртїе, и҆ въ свѣ́тѣ живы́й непристꙊ́пнымъ, ка́кѡ совокꙊпи́вшеся съ кꙋми́ромъ тмы̀ грѣхо́вныхъ; но ѽ Свѣ́те! просвѣща́яй вся́каго чл҃ка, не сокрꙊшѝ и҆ не и҆зве́ргни въ тмꙊ̀ кромѣ́шную те́мныя и҆ грѣ́шныя дꙊ́шы на́шя; но просвѣтѝ я҆̀ бл҃го́стїю твое́ю мо́лимся, млⷭ҇рдїя пꙊчи́ною Хрⷭ҇тѐ преесте́ственный.
items.english_text: When the Ark was brought low, David the ancestor of God leaped and danced; but we today bow down unto Him as God, Whom the Ark prefigured in His humanity; for instead of manna, the Godhead incarnate, and instead of the tablets of the Law, Christ the Lawgiver is seen hidden, saving our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: When the Ark was brought low, David the ancestor of God leaped and danced; but we today bow down unto Him as God, Whom the Ark prefigured in His humanity; for instead of manna, the Godhead incarnate, and instead of the tablets of the Law, Christ the Lawgiver is seen hidden, saving our souls.

items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же еди́нъ и҆мѣ́яй безсме́ртїе, и҆ въ свѣ́тѣ живы́й непристꙊ́пнымъ, ка́кѡ совокꙊпи́вшеся съ кꙋми́ромъ тмы̀ грѣхо́вныхъ; но ѽ Свѣ́те! просвѣща́яй вся́каго чл҃ка, не сокрꙊшѝ и҆ не и҆зве́ргни въ тмꙊ̀ кромѣ́шную те́мныя и҆ грѣ́шныя дꙊ́шы на́шя; но просвѣтѝ я҆̀ бл҃го́стїю твое́ю мо́лимся, млⷭ҇рдїя пꙊчи́ною Хрⷭ҇тѐ преесте́ственный.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* The Old Covenant possessed the Ark overlaid round about with gold, which was captured by the Philistines; it endured not to abide in the temple with the idol, but cast it down unto the earth, and broke its head and both palms of its hands. But Thou, O Christ our God, Lover of mankind, how wilt Thou enter into the temple of our wretched and defiled souls?

provenance.verbatim_source:

But Thou, O Christ our God, Lover of mankind, how wilt Thou enter into the temple of our wretched and defiled souls?

items.section: At the Litiya, Stichera. Tone 6
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆́же еди́нъ и҆мѣ́яй безсме́ртїе, и҆ въ свѣ́тѣ живы́й непристꙊ́пнымъ, ка́кѡ совокꙊпи́вшеся съ кꙋми́ромъ тмы̀ грѣхо́вныхъ; но ѽ Свѣ́те! просвѣща́яй вся́каго чл҃ка, не сокрꙊшѝ и҆ не и҆зве́ргни въ тмꙊ̀ кромѣ́шную те́мныя и҆ грѣ́шныя дꙊ́шы на́шя; но просвѣтѝ я҆̀ бл҃го́стїю твое́ю мо́лимся, млⷭ҇рдїя пꙊчи́ною Хрⷭ҇тѐ преесте́ственный.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* Thou Who alone hast immortality, and dwellest in light unapproachable, how hast Thou joined Thyself with the idol of the darkness of sins? But O Light That enlightenest every man, shatter not nor cast forth into outer darkness our dark and sinful souls; but enlighten them by Thy goodness, we beseech Thee, O Christ beyond nature, Thou Abyss of tender mercy.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron 3:*

items.section: At the Litiya, Stichera. Tone 6
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Та́йнѣй дне́сь ве́чери, и҆ трапе́зѣ Бж҃е́ственной, со стра́хомъ приближа́емся вѣ́рнїи, хотя́ще вкꙊси́ти и҆сто́чника безсме́ртнаго, но тре́петъ и҆ стра́хъ на́съ прїе́млетъ, мно́гихъ ра́ди грѣхо́въ на́шихъ, ѿ ни́хже токо́ю ѡ҆чи́ститися жела́емъ, мл҃твами Бц҃ы Влⷣчцы на́шея.
items.english_text: O gentle Lamb, That takest away the sins of the whole world, for the sake of man's salvation Thou didst transform bread into Thy Flesh; and in the bread Thou didst conceal the Godhead, Flesh, and soul by Divine power, Whom all we the faithful today festively worship with compunction and faith.

provenance.verbatim_source: O gentle Lamb, That takest away the sins of the whole world, for the sake of man's salvation Thou didst transform bread into Thy Flesh; and in the bread Thou didst conceal the Godhead, Flesh, and soul by Divine power, Whom all we the faithful today festively worship with compunction and faith.

items.section: At the Litiya, Stichera. Tone 6
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Хлѣ́бъ нб҃ный живо́тный воспое́мъ, съ нб҃се непреста́нно сходя́щь неизрече́нно, глаго́люще є҆диномꙋ́дренно, Тѣ́ло Хрⷭ҇то́во: и҆́мже всѝ и҆зба́вихомся, ра́дꙊемся, и҆ Кро́вь Бж҃е́ственная и҆ ст҃а́я, е́юже и҆скꙊпи́хомся.
items.english_text: Unto the mystical supper today and the Divine table, we the faithful approach with fear, desiring to taste of the immortal fountain; but trembling and fear seize us because of our many sins, wherefrom we desire to be cleansed by the tears of repentance, by the prayers of the Mother of God our Sovereign Lady.

provenance.verbatim_source: Unto the mystical supper today and the Divine table, we the faithful approach with fear, desiring to taste of the immortal fountain; but trembling and fear seize us because of our many sins, wherefrom we desire to be cleansed by the tears of repentance, by the prayers of the Mother of God our Sovereign Lady.

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera. Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the Heavenly Ranks" (Небным чином)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃і. И҆ ѡ҆дождѝ и҆̀мъ ма́ннꙊ я́сти, и҆ хлѣ́бъ нб҃ный дадѐ и҆̀мъ.
items.english_text: Let us praise the heavenly Living Bread, Who comes down unceasingly from heaven ineffably, saying with one mind: The Body of Christ, whereby we all are delivered, let us rejoice, and the Divine and holy Blood, wherewith we have been redeemed.

provenance.verbatim_source: Let us praise the heavenly Living Bread, Who comes down unceasingly from heaven ineffably, saying with one mind: The Body of Christ, whereby we all are delivered, let us rejoice, and the Divine and holy Blood, wherewith we have been redeemed.

items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* At supper Thou didst give Thine own self, O marvelous wonder, unto which disciples and friends as food: Eat bread, for this is My Body; and taking the cup Thou didst say: Drink ye all, this is My Blood.

items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Пр[е]сто́й Та́инѣ Еv́харї́стїи. Нн҃ѣ ѿпꙊща́еши: и҆ про́: Тропа́рь Гла́съ з҃.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O Divine, most honorable, and dearest Body of the God-man Word, save Thy servants from the affliction of many temptations and great distresses, granting the Heavenly Kingdom and life, for the sake of Thy mercy.

items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: ѾпꙊ́стъ. Премно́гїя ра́ди мл҃ти, на та́инной свое́й ве́чери Пло́ть свою̀ я́сти, и҆ Кро́вь свою̀ и҆́стиннꙊю пи́ти на сп҃се́нїе да́вый на́мъ, Хрⷭ҇то́съ и҆́стинный Бг҃ъ на́шъ: моли́твами Пречи́стыя своя̀ Мт҃ре, сты́хъ а҆́пѡстолъ двана́десяте, и҆ всѣ́хъ сты́хъ, поми́лꙊетъ и҆ спасе́тъ на́съ, я҆́ко бл҃ги́й Бг҃ъ, и҆ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_text: O most glorious wonder! The Living and Divine Bread, having descended from heaven, was freely given for food at the mystical supper; for taking bread He blessed and gave it, saying unto the disciples: Take and eat, this is My Body; likewise also the cup. Therefore let each man examine himself, and so let him eat and drink unto forgiveness and eternal life.

provenance.verbatim_source: O most glorious wonder! Therefore let each man examine himself, and so let him eat and drink unto forgiveness and eternal life.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ.
items.english_text: The supernatural Bread, Whom the angels and archangels with trembling desire to behold, is seen today festively upon the Altar, and is given unto men for food; wherein we, beholding Thy most rich mercy, O Christ our God, confess Thee with the Flesh to be God hidden beneath the appearance of the species, saying with invincible voice: Make us worthy to be partakers, that we may enjoy eternal life.

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera. Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the Heavenly Ranks" (Небным чином)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: По второ́й Каѳі́смѣ сѣда́ленъ Гла́съ д҃.
items.english_text: Christ our true God, Who for the sake of His exceeding great mercy gave us His Flesh to eat and His true Blood to drink unto salvation at His mystical supper: by the prayers of His most pure Mother, of the holy twelve Apostles, and of all the saints, have mercy on us and save us, as He is a good God and Lover of mankind.

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera. Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the Heavenly Ranks" (Небным чином)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Хлѣ́бъ нб҃ный и҆ ча́шꙊ взе́мъ Хрⷭ҇то́съ бл҃гословѝ, показа̀ Ѻ҆ц҃Ꙋ́ Роди́телю, и҆ дивя́щымся Оу҆ченико́мъ, подава́я глаго́лаше: яди́те моѐ Пло́ть, и҆ пїя́й мою̀ Кро́вь и҆́матъ живо́тъ вѣ́чный, и҆ а҆́зъ воскрешꙊ̀ его̀ въ послѣ́днїй де́нь. Сего̀ ра́ди мы̀ недосто́йнїи, дне́сь пра́зденственно кла́няемся пречи́стымъ Та́йнамъ пло́ти и҆ Кро́ви твоея̀, дерзнове́нно вѣ́рꙊюще [продолженіе на слѣд. листѣ]
items.english_text: Our great and most venerable Passover is Christ; having been eaten as bread, having been slain as a Lamb, He was offered for us an acceptable sacrifice unto God; Whose most pure Body and precious Blood piously worshiping, we say with compunction: Dwell Thou ever with us Thyself, and no one can do anything against us.

provenance.verbatim_source: Our great and most venerable Passover is Christ; having been eaten as bread, having been slain as a Lamb, He was offered for us an acceptable sacrifice unto God; Whose most pure Body and precious Blood piously worshiping, we say with compunction: Dwell Thou ever with us Thyself, and no one can do anything against us.

items.english_text: O Birthgiver of God, Ever-Virgin Mary, behold the Flesh of thy Son, Christ our God, which He received from thy womb by the operation of the Most Holy Spirit, and at the mystical supper gave unto His disciples, saying: Take, eat, this is My Body, and drink, this is My Blood. Him do thou beseech with maternal boldness, that He consume not us who partake, but save our souls.

items.slavonic_text: Безсѣ́менно ѿ Дх҃а Ст҃а̀ зачала̀ и҆ родила̀ есѝ Сы́на Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а на́шего, его́же пречи́стой Пло́ти, я҆́ко Бг҃Ꙋ и҆ И҆зба́вителю на́шемꙊ до лица̀ землѝ покланя́емся, и҆ прича́стницы бы́ти жела́емъ; и҆ къ тебѣ̀ я҆́ко Мт҃ри прибѣга́емъ Пречⷭ҇тая Бц҃е, оу҆ми́лно глаго́люще моли́мъ тя̀: прїимѝ мл҃твы на́шя, и҆ донесѝ я҆̀ Сн҃Ꙋ своемꙊ̀ и҆ Бг҃Ꙋ на́шемꙊ, да сп҃се́тъ дꙊ́шы на́шя.
items.english_text: Seedlessly from the Holy Spirit thou didst conceive and bare the Son, Christ our God, Whose most pure Flesh, as God and our Redeemer, we bow down unto the face of the earth, and desire to be partakers; and unto thee as Mother we flee, O Most Pure Birthgiver of God, saying with compunction we beseech thee: Receive our prayers, and bear them unto thy Son and our God, that He may save our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: Seedlessly from the Holy Spirit thou didst conceive and bare the Son, Christ our God, Whose most pure Flesh, as God and our Redeemer, we bow down unto the face of the earth, and desire to be partakers; and unto thee as Mother we flee, O Most Pure Birthgiver of God, saying with compunction we beseech thee: Receive our prayers, and bear them unto thy Son and our God, that He may save our souls.

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera. Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the Heavenly Ranks" (Небным чином)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Ст҃і, а҃. Ве́лїй Гдⷭ҇ь и҆ хва́ленъ зѣло̀, во гра́дѣ Бг҃а на́шего въ горѣ̀ ст҃ѣ́й его̀. Ст҃і, в҃. Что̀ возда́мъ Гдⷭ҇ви ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ, я҆̀же воздаде́ ми, ча́шꙊ сп҃се́нїя. Ст҃і, г҃. Па́мять сотвори́лъ е́сть чуде́съ свои́хъ, мл҃тивъ Гдⷭ҇ь и҆ ще́дръ пи́щꙊ дадѐ боя́щымся его̀. Ст҃і, д҃. Ѡ҆дождѝ и҆̀мъ ма́ннꙊ я́сти, и҆ хлѣ́бъ нб҃ный да́стъ и҆̀мъ, хлѣ́бъ а҆́гглскїй ядѐ чл҃къ, бра́шно посла̀ и҆̀мъ до сы́тїя.
items.english_text: We magnify Thee, O Christ Giver of life, Who for our sake didst transform bread into Flesh and wine into Thy Blood, Whom today as God incarnate we bow down and worship.

provenance.verbatim_source: We magnify Thee, O Christ Giver of life, Who for our sake didst transform bread into Flesh and wine into Thy Blood, Whom today as God incarnate we bow down and worship.

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera. Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the Heavenly Ranks" (Небным чином)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Кро́вь твою̀ Влⷣко пречи́стꙊю, и҆ Тѣ́ло твоѐ прⷭ҇то́е, менѐ сподо́би я́стиже и҆ пи́ти; со жела́нїемъ и҆ вѣ́рою.
items.english_text: The pre-eternal and unoriginate God, Who assumed human nature, came into the prepared upper room with His disciples, where Thou didst bring to an end the old Passover, O our Savior, and didst make a new mystical Passover; for taking bread He transformed it into His Flesh, and the cup into Blood, and gave them unto us for food and drink. Beholding today this Divine mystery, we say with compunction: Glory to Thy tender mercy, O Lover of mankind!

provenance.verbatim_source: The pre-eternal and unoriginate God, Who assumed human nature, came into the prepared upper room with His disciples, where Thou didst bring to an end the old Passover, O our Savior, and didst make a new mystical Passover; for taking bread He transformed it into His Flesh, and the cup into Blood, and gave them unto us for food and drink. Beholding today this Divine mystery, we say with compunction: Glory to Thy tender mercy, O Lover of mankind!

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera. Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the Heavenly Ranks" (Небным чином)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Сле́зныя мѝ пода́ждь Хрⷭ҇тѐ ка́пли, скве́рнꙊ се́рдца ѡ҆чища́ющыя; я҆́ко да бл҃го́ю со́вѣстїю ѡ҆чище́нъ вѣ́рою прихождꙋ̀ и҆ стра́хомъ Влⷣко, ко причаще́нїю даро́въ твои́хъ.
items.english_text: The Lord said unto the Jews who came to Him: My Flesh is meat indeed... The end: He shall live unto ages.

provenance.verbatim_source: The Lord said unto the Jews who came to Him: My Flesh is meat indeed... The end: He shall live unto ages.

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera. Tone 1, Podoben: "Joy of the Heavenly Ranks" (Небным чином)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Во ѡ҆ставле́нїе да бꙊ́детъ мѝ прегрѣше́нїй прчⷭ҇тое Тѣ́ло твоѐ, и҆ Бж҃е́ственная кро́вь, Дх҃а же ст҃а́го Ѻ҆бще́нїе, и҆ въ жи́знь вѣ́чнꙊю чл҃колю́бче: и҆ страсте́й ѿчꙊжде́нїе.
items.english_text: *Sticheron after the Gospel, Tone 6:* Today the angels are astonished, beholding Thee, the incarnate God, hidden in the Mysteries, worshiped with fear by men, and given for food; with them also we earthly ones praise Thee, the Master and Lover of mankind, saying: Make us worthy to partake of the most pure Flesh and Blood, O merciful Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron after the Gospel, Tone 6:*
Today the angels are astonished, beholding Thee, the incarnate God, hidden in the Mysteries, worshiped with fear by men, and given for food; with them also we earthly ones praise Thee, the Master and Lover of mankind, saying: Make us worthy to partake of the most pure Flesh and Blood, O merciful Lord!

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Хлѣ́ба живо́тнаго трапе́за прчⷭ҇тая: свы́шне ми́лости ра́ди соше́дшаго мі́рови живо́тъ даю́щаго: и҆ менѐ нн҃ѣ сподо́би недосто́йнаго, со стра́хомъ вкꙊси́ти сегѡ̀ и҆ жи́вꙊ бы́ти.
items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos: Come, ye people, let us sing a song unto Christ God...* *Refrain before each troparion: Glory, O Christ, to Thy Flesh and Blood.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 1. Heirmos: Come, ye people, let us sing a song unto Christ God...*
*Refrain before each troparion: Glory, O Christ, to Thy Flesh and Blood.*

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Хлѣ́ба живо́тнаго трапе́за прчⷭ҇тая: свы́шне ми́лости ра́ди соше́дшаго мі́рови живо́тъ даю́щаго: и҆ менѐ нн҃ѣ сподо́би недосто́йнаго, со стра́хомъ вкꙊси́ти сегѡ̀ и҆ жи́вꙊ бы́ти.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* The Bread of eternal life: may Thy holy Body be unto me, O compassionate Lord, and Thy precious Blood the healing of diverse diseases.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion 1:*
The Bread of eternal life: may Thy holy Body be unto me, O compassionate Lord, and Thy precious Blood the healing of diverse diseases.

items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Хлѣ́ба живо́тнаго трапе́за прчⷭ҇тая: свы́шне ми́лости ра́ди соше́дшаго мі́рови живо́тъ даю́щаго: и҆ менѐ нн҃ѣ сподо́би недосто́йнаго, со стра́хомъ вкꙊси́ти сегѡ̀ и҆ жи́вꙊ бы́ти.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Thy most pure Blood, O Master, and Thy most holy Body, make me worthy to eat and drink with desire and faith.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion 2:*
Thy most pure Blood, O Master, and Thy most holy Body, make me worthy to eat and drink with desire and faith.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Хлѣ́ба живо́тнаго трапе́за прчⷭ҇тая: свы́шне ми́лости ра́ди соше́дшаго мі́рови живо́тъ даю́щаго: и҆ менѐ нн҃ѣ сподо́би недосто́йнаго, со стра́хомъ вкꙊси́ти сегѡ̀ и҆ жи́вꙊ бы́ти.
items.english_text: Defiled by unfitting deeds, I the wretched one am unworthy to partake of Thy most pure Body and Divine Blood, O Christ: whereof do Thou make me worthy.

provenance.verbatim_source: Defiled by unfitting deeds, I the wretched one am unworthy to partake of Thy most pure Body and Divine Blood, O Christ: whereof do Thou make me worthy.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Хлѣ́ба живо́тнаго трапе́за прчⷭ҇тая: свы́шне ми́лости ра́ди соше́дшаго мі́рови живо́тъ даю́щаго: и҆ менѐ нн҃ѣ сподо́би недосто́йнаго, со стра́хомъ вкꙊси́ти сегѡ̀ и҆ жи́вꙊ бы́ти.
items.english_text: O good land, blessed bride, that didst bud forth the unplowed and world-saving ear of grain: make me worthy, eating this, to be saved.

provenance.verbatim_source: O good land, blessed bride, that didst bud forth the unplowed and world-saving ear of grain: make me worthy, eating this, to be saved.

Heirmos: I shall open my mouth...* Grant me, O Christ, teardrops that cleanse the defilement of my heart; that cleansed with a good conscience, I may approach with faith and fear, O Master, unto the communion of Thy gifts.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Хлѣ́ба живо́тнаго трапе́за прчⷭ҇тая: свы́шне ми́лости ра́ди соше́дшаго мі́рови живо́тъ даю́щаго: и҆ менѐ нн҃ѣ сподо́би недосто́йнаго, со стра́хомъ вкꙊси́ти сегѡ̀ и҆ жи́вꙊ бы́ти.
items.english_text: Make me worthy, O Lord, to partake uncondemned of Thy Body, and of Thy precious Blood, and to glorify Thy goodness.

provenance.verbatim_source: Make me worthy, O Lord, to partake uncondemned of Thy Body, and of Thy precious Blood, and to glorify Thy goodness.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Хлѣ́ба живо́тнаго трапе́за прчⷭ҇тая: свы́шне ми́лости ра́ди соше́дшаго мі́рови живо́тъ даю́щаго: и҆ менѐ нн҃ѣ сподо́би недосто́йнаго, со стра́хомъ вкꙊси́ти сегѡ̀ и҆ жи́вꙊ бы́ти.
items.english_text: Most pure table of the Living Bread, Who for the sake of mercy from on high descended to give life unto the world: make me also now worthy, unworthy though I be, to taste thereof with fear and to live.[^10]

provenance.verbatim_source: Most pure table of the Living Bread, Who for the sake of mercy from on high descended to give life unto the world: make me also now worthy, unworthy though I be, to taste thereof with fear and to live.[^10]

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Я҆ды́й Влⷣко съ Оу҆ченикѝ свои́ми а҆́гнца по за́повѣди Мѡѷсе́я, себѐ а҆́гнца непоро́чна та́инственно въ снѣ́дь да́лъ есѝ на́мъ; во ѡ҆ставле́нїе грѣхѡ́въ, во ѡ҆сщ҃енїе дꙊша́мъ, и҆́мже пита́ющеся мо́лимъ: да не бꙊ́детъ и҆лѝ въ сꙊ́дъ и҆лѝ въ во ѡ҆сꙊжде́нїе кꙊ́детъ прича́стїе ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ Та́инъ, грѣ́хъ ра́ди и҆ беззако́нїй на́шихъ.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 1, Podoben: "When the stone had been sealed" (Камени знаменану):* *Katavasia: O Birthgiver of God, fountain of living water...* Eating the Lamb with Thy disciples according to the commandment of Moses, Thou, the spotless Lamb, didst mystically give Thyself unto us for food; unto the remission of sins, unto sanctification of souls, whereon feeding we pray: Let not the communion of Thy holy Mysteries become unto judgment or condemnation, because of our sins and transgressions.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: O Birthgiver of God, fountain of living water...*
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 1, Podoben: "When the stone had been sealed" (Камени знаменану):*
Eating the Lamb with Thy disciples according to the commandment of Moses, Thou, the spotless Lamb, didst mystically give Thyself unto us for food; unto the remission of sins, unto sanctification of souls, whereon feeding we pray: Let not the communion of Thy holy Mysteries become unto judgment or condemnation, because of our sins and transgressions.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: А҆́гница и҆ Па́стыря Мт҃и Дв҃о Бц҃е, оу҆молѝ, его́же родила̀ есѝ Сн҃а, да сп҃се́тъ и҆ просвѣти́тъ дꙊ́шы на́шя.
items.english_text: O Virgin Birthgiver of God, Mother of the Lamb and Shepherd, beseech the Son Whom thou didst bear, that He may save and enlighten our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Virgin Birthgiver of God, Mother of the Lamb and Shepherd, beseech the Son Whom thou didst bear, that He may save and enlighten our souls.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь д҃, І҆рмо́съ. Прише́лъ есѝ ѿ Дв҃ы:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* *Ode 4. Heirmos: Thou hast come forth from the Virgin...* Thou didst will to become incarnate for our sake, O most merciful One, to be slain as a sheep for the sake of human sins: therefore I beseech Thee, cleanse also my transgressions.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4. Heirmos: Thou hast come forth from the Virgin...*
*Troparion 1:*
Thou didst will to become incarnate for our sake, O most merciful One, to be slain as a sheep for the sake of human sins: therefore I beseech Thee, cleanse also my transgressions.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Восхотѣ́лъ есѝ на́съ дѣ́ля вопло́щся многоми́лостиве; закла́нъ бы́ти я҆́ко Ѻ҆вча̀, грѣ́хъ ра́ди человѣ́ческихъ: тѣ́мже молю́ тя, и҆ моя̀ ѡ҆чи́сти прегрѣше́нїя.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Heal the wounds of my soul, O Lord, and sanctify me wholly; and make me worthy, O Master, that I the wretched one may become a partaker of Thy mystical Divine supper.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion 2:*
Heal the wounds of my soul, O Lord, and sanctify me wholly; and make me worthy, O Master, that I the wretched one may become a partaker of Thy mystical Divine supper.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: Standing and groaning with fear and trembling, I lift up the eyes of my right hand on high unto Thee, O Savior, Who didst stretch forth both Thy hands upon the Cross; wherewith grant me the food of Thy good pleasure, establishing me and strengthening me in Thy fear.

provenance.verbatim_source: Standing and groaning with fear and trembling, I lift up the eyes of my right hand on high unto Thee, O Savior, Who didst stretch forth both Thy hands upon the Cross; wherewith grant me the food of Thy good pleasure, establishing me and strengthening me in Thy fear.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: Make Thy tender-hearted Son merciful also unto me, O Sovereign Lady, and keep me Thy servant without defilement and without blemish: that receiving inwardly the spiritual pearl, I may be sanctified.

provenance.verbatim_source: Make Thy tender-hearted Son merciful also unto me, O Sovereign Lady, and keep me Thy servant without defilement and without blemish: that receiving inwardly the spiritual pearl, I may be sanctified.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Ми́лостива и҆ мнѣ̀ сотворѝ бл҃гоꙋтро́бнаго Сн҃а твоего́ Влⷣчце, и҆ соблюдѝ мя̀ без̾ скве́рны раба̀ твоего́ и҆ без̾ поро́ка: я҆́ко да внꙊ́трь прїе́мъ оу҆́мнымъ би́серъ ѡ҆сщ҃ꙋ́ся.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* *Ode 5. Heirmos: O Christ, illumination of them that lie in darkness...* *Katavasia: He Who sits in glory...* As Thou didst foretell, O Christ, let it be unto Thy humble servant; and abide in me, as Thou didst promise: for behold, I eat Thy Divine Body and drink Thy Blood.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: He Who sits in glory...*
*Ode 5. Heirmos: O Christ, illumination of them that lie in darkness...*
*Troparion 1:*
As Thou didst foretell, O Christ, let it be unto Thy humble servant; and abide in me, as Thou didst promise: for behold, I eat Thy Divine Body and drink Thy Blood.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Катава́сїа: Сѣдя́й въ сла́вѣ:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Word of God and God, let the live coal of Thy Body be unto the illumination of me the darkened one, and Thy Blood unto the cleansing of my defiled soul.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion 2:*
O Word of God and God, let the live coal of Thy Body be unto the illumination of me the darkened one, and Thy Blood unto the cleansing of my defiled soul.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Я҆́коже прере́клъ есѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, да бꙊ́детъ оу҆́бо хꙊдо́мꙊ рабꙊ̀ твое́мꙊ; и҆ въ мнѣ̀ пребꙊ́ди, я҆́коже ѡ҆бѣща́лся есѝ: се́ бо Тѣ́ло твоѐ я҆́мъ Бж҃е́ственное, и҆ пїю̀ Кро́вь твою̀.
items.english_text: Having an exceedingly defiled soul and unclean lips, I dare not approach unto Thee, O Christ, and receive Thy Body: but do Thou make me worthy.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having an exceedingly defiled soul and unclean lips, I dare not approach unto Thee, O Christ, and receive Thy Body: but do Thou make me worthy.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: O Mary, Mother of God, honorable dwelling of sweet fragrance, by thy prayers make me a chosen vessel: that I may partake of the Holy Mysteries of thy Son.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Mary, Mother of God, honorable dwelling of sweet fragrance, by thy prayers make me a chosen vessel: that I may partake of the Holy Mysteries of thy Son.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Преѡскверне́нꙊ дꙊ́шꙊ и҆ оу҆стнѣ̀ и҆мы́й нечи́стѣ, несми́ю ни́къ прибли́житися к тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, и҆ прїя́ти Тѣ́ло твоѐ: но ты́ мя я҆вѝ досто́йна.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* *Ode 6. Heirmos: In the abyss of sins...* *Katavasia: All creation was astonished...* Sanctify my mind, soul, and heart, O Savior, and my body; and make me worthy without condemnation, O Master, to approach Thy dread Mysteries.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: All creation was astonished...*
*Ode 6. Heirmos: In the abyss of sins...*
*Troparion 1:*
Sanctify my mind, soul, and heart, O Savior, and my body; and make me worthy without condemnation, O Master, to approach Thy dread Mysteries.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* May I be alienated from passions, being accounted worthy to have an increase of Thy grace, and the confirmation of life, through the communion of Thy holy Mysteries, O Christ.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion 2:*
May I be alienated from passions, being accounted worthy to have an increase of Thy grace, and the confirmation of life, through the communion of Thy holy Mysteries, O Christ.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Катава́: Оу҆диви́шася вся́ческая:
items.english_text: Grant me with fear and trembling to approach Thy Divine Mysteries, O Christ, and to receive Thy true and holy Body, and Thy true and holy and precious Blood.

provenance.verbatim_source: Grant me with fear and trembling to approach Thy Divine Mysteries, O Christ, and to receive Thy true and holy Body, and Thy true and holy and precious Blood.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́мъ, дꙊ́шꙊ, и҆ се́рдце ѡ҆святѝ Сп҃се, и҆ тѣ́ло моѐ: и҆ сподо́би мя̀ неѡсꙊжде́нно Влⷣко, къ стра́шнымъ Та́йнамъ пристꙊпи́ти.
items.english_text: O Holy Word of God, O God, sanctify me wholly, who now come unto Thy Divine Mysteries, by the entreaties of Thy Holy Mother.

provenance.verbatim_source: O Holy Word of God, O God, sanctify me wholly, who now come unto Thy Divine Mysteries, by the entreaties of Thy Holy Mother.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Да оу҆страня́юся ѡ҆ страсте́й, твоея̀ бл҃года́ти сподо́бленъ и҆мѣ́ти прило́гъ; живота́ же оу҆твержде́нїе, причаще́нїя ра́ди ст҃ы́хъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ твои́хъ Та́инъ.
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 4:* *Katavasia: This Divine and most honorable feast...* Behold, Christ lies before us as food for all: come, and falling down let us worship Christ God hidden in these Mysteries, crying aloud with compunction: O Master, consume us not the unworthy by communion, but be Thou the consumer of sins and the cleanser of our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: This Divine and most honorable feast...*
*Kontakion, Tone 4:*
Behold, Christ lies before us as food for all: come, and falling down let us worship Christ God hidden in these Mysteries, crying aloud with compunction: O Master, consume us not the unworthy by communion, but be Thou the consumer of sins and the cleanser of our souls.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Having all drawn near unto the mystical table with fear, with pure souls let us receive the Divine Bread and the cup of salvation, having washed the feet of our conscience: that we may enjoy eternal life by the prayers of the Mother of God.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ikos:*
Having all drawn near unto the mystical table with fear, with pure souls let us receive the Divine Bread and the cup of salvation, having washed the feet of our conscience: that we may enjoy eternal life by the prayers of the Mother of God.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Со стра́хомъ и҆ тре́петомъ пристꙊпи́ти да́ждь мѝ къ Бж҃е́ственнымъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ твои̑мъ Та́йнамъ, и҆сто́еже и҆ ст҃о́е Тѣ́ло твоѐ прїя́ти; и҆ и҆́стꙊю и҆ ст҃Ꙋ́ю и҆ чⷭ҇тнꙊ́ю Кро́вь твою̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* *Ode 7. Heirmos: Concerning the golden image...* May the communion of Thine immortal Mysteries now be unto me, I pray, O Christ, a fountain of good things, light, life, and dispassion: conducing unto the advancement and increase of most divine virtue, O Thou only Good: that I may glorify Thee.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 7. Heirmos: Concerning the golden image...*
*Troparion 1:*
May the communion of Thine immortal Mysteries now be unto me, I pray, O Christ, a fountain of good things, light, life, and dispassion: conducing unto the advancement and increase of most divine virtue, O Thou only Good: that I may glorify Thee.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* That I may be delivered from passions, from enemies, necessities, and every affliction, with trembling, love, and piety, O Lover of mankind: approaching now unto the venerable, immortal, and Divine Mysteries, and make me worthy that I may sing unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion 2:*
That I may be delivered from passions, from enemies, necessities, and every affliction, with trembling, love, and piety, O Lover of mankind: approaching now unto the venerable, immortal, and Divine Mysteries, and make me worthy that I may sing unto Thee: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: O my wretched soul, O passionate soul, be astonished beholding the most glorious Mysteries! Sighing, weep, beating thy breast, calling out and saying: Cleanse me even as the prodigal!

provenance.verbatim_source: O my wretched soul, O passionate soul, be astonished beholding the most glorious Mysteries! Sighing, weep, beating thy breast, calling out and saying: Cleanse me even as the prodigal!

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Катава́сїа: Не послꙊжи́ша тва́ри:
items.english_text: Having borne Christ the Savior beyond understanding, O thou who art full of God's grace: I thy defiled servant earnestly beseech thee, O pure one: desiring now to approach unto the most pure Mysteries, cleanse me wholly from defilement of flesh and spirit.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having borne Christ the Savior beyond understanding, O thou who art full of God's grace: I thy defiled servant earnestly beseech thee, O pure one: desiring now to approach unto the most pure Mysteries, cleanse me wholly from defilement of flesh and spirit.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь и҃, І҆рмо́съ. Ѡ подо́бїи зла́тѣ небрего́ша:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* *Ode 8. Heirmos: They disregarded the golden image...* *Katavasia: The children did not serve creation...* Of Thy heavenly, dread, and holy Mysteries now, O Christ, and of Thy Divine and mystical supper, make me worthy to be a partaker, O God my Savior.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: The children did not serve creation...*
*Ode 8. Heirmos: They disregarded the golden image...*
*Troparion 1:*
Of Thy heavenly, dread, and holy Mysteries now, O Christ, and of Thy Divine and mystical supper, make me worthy to be a partaker, O God my Savior.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Нб҃ныхъ стра́шныхъ и҆ ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ нн҃ѣ Та́инъ, Бж҃е́ственныя же твоея̀ и҆ та́инныя Ве́чери, ѡ҆бщника бы́ти менѐ сподо́би Бж҃е Сп҃си́телю мо́й.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Fleeing unto Thy tender mercy, O Good One, with fear I cry: Abide in me, O Savior, and I, as Thou hast said, in Thee; for behold, trusting in Thy mercy, I eat Thy Body and drink Thy Blood.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion 2:*
Fleeing unto Thy tender mercy, O Good One, with fear I cry: Abide in me, O Savior, and I, as Thou hast said, in Thee; for behold, trusting in Thy mercy, I eat Thy Body and drink Thy Blood.

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: I shudder receiving the Fire, lest I be burned as wax and as grass; O the tender mercy of God! O the dread Mystery! How do I, who am clay, partake of the Divine Body and Blood, and am made incorruptible!

provenance.verbatim_source: I shudder receiving the Fire, lest I be burned as wax and as grass; O the tender mercy of God! O the dread Mystery! How do I, who am clay, partake of the Divine Body and Blood, and am made incorruptible!

items.section: Canon — Ode 1
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: The Divine Bread of life was incorruptibly baked within thy womb, O Mother of God, preserving thine immaculate womb uninjured: therefore as our Nourisher we praise thee unto all ages.

provenance.verbatim_source: The Divine Bread of life was incorruptibly baked within thy womb, O Mother of God, preserving thine immaculate womb uninjured: therefore as our Nourisher we praise thee unto all ages.

items.section: Canon — Ode 9
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Бж҃е́ственный Хлѣ́бъ жи́зны въ чре́вѣ твое́мъ Бг҃ома́ти нетлѣ́нно и҆спече́ся, сохра́нься невредна ложесна̀ твоя̀ непоро́чна: тѣ́мже я҆́ко Пита́тельницꙊ на́шꙊ пое́мъ тя̀ въ вся̀ вѣ́ки.
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Before the Heirmos, we sing the Refrain:* *Katavasia: The pious youths in the furnace...* *Refrain: Magnify, O my soul, the Lord Who gave His Flesh in food as a Mystery.*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: The pious youths in the furnace...*
*Ode 9. Before the Heirmos, we sing the Refrain:*
*Refrain: Magnify, O my soul, the Lord Who gave His Flesh in food as a Mystery.*

items.section: Canon — Ode 9
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Пр[е]сто́й Та́инѣ Еv́харї́стїи. І҆рмо́съ. Бе́з̾ сѣ́мене зача́тїе:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* *Ode 9. Heirmos: Conception without seed...* Taste Christ God, and see that the Lord of old, having become for our sake, once offered Himself as a sacrifice unto His Father, and is ever slain, sanctifying them that partake.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 9. Heirmos: Conception without seed...*
*Troparion 1:*
Taste Christ God, and see that the Lord of old, having become for our sake, once offered Himself as a sacrifice unto His Father, and is ever slain, sanctifying them that partake.

items.section: Canon — Ode 9
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Хрⷭ҇то́съ Бг҃ъ вкꙊси́те, и҆ оу҆ви́дите я҆́ко Гдⷭ҇ь дре́вле бы́въ на́съ дѣ́ля, еди́ною себѐ принесѐ, я҆́ко же́ртвꙊ Ѻ҆ц҃Ꙋ̀ своему̀, при́сно закала́ется ѡ҆сщ҃а́я причаща́ющихъ ся.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* May I be sanctified in soul and body, O Master, may I be enlightened, may I be saved, may I become Thy dwelling through the communion of the Sacred Mysteries: having Thee dwelling within myself with the Father and the Spirit, by grace, O most merciful One.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion 2:*
May I be sanctified in soul and body, O Master, may I be enlightened, may I be saved, may I become Thy dwelling through the communion of the Sacred Mysteries: having Thee dwelling within myself with the Father and the Spirit, by grace, O most merciful One.

items.section: Canon — Ode 9
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва:
items.english_text: Like fire may Thy Body be unto me, and like light, and Thy most pure Blood, O my Savior: burning up the matter of sin, consuming the thorns of passions, and wholly enlightening me who worship Thy Godhead.

provenance.verbatim_source: Like fire may Thy Body be unto me, and like light, and Thy most pure Blood, O my Savior: burning up the matter of sin, consuming the thorns of passions, and wholly enlightening me who worship Thy Godhead.

items.section: Canon — Ode 9
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ:
items.english_text: God became incarnate of thy pure blood, therefore every generation praises thee, O Sovereign Lady; and the spiritual hosts glorify thee, for through thee they clearly beheld Him Who rules over all, substantiated in human nature.

provenance.verbatim_source: God became incarnate of thy pure blood, therefore every generation praises thee, O Sovereign Lady; and the spiritual hosts glorify thee, for through thee they clearly beheld Him Who rules over all, substantiated in human nature.

items.section: Canon — Ode 9
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ъ воплоти́лся е́сть ѿ чⷭ҇тыхъ крове́й твои́хъ, ѿню́дꙊже вся́къ ро́дъ пое́тъ тя̀ Влⷣчце: оу҆́мная же мно́жества сла́вятъ тя̀, я҆́ко тобо́ю я҆́вѣ оу҆зрѣ́ша всѣ́ми влады́чествующаго, ѡ҆сꙊществова́вшагося человѣ́чествомъ.
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion:* *Katavasia: Let every earthborn mortal...* While the disciples were sitting at the Mystical Supper and beholding Thee, O Lord, taking bread into Thy holy hands, lifting up Thine eyes to Heaven unto God the Father, having given thanks, Thou didst bless and break it, and gavest it unto Thy Holy Disciples: Grant it also unto us, Thy sinful servants.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: Let every earthborn mortal...*
*Exapostilarion:*
While the disciples were sitting at the Mystical Supper and beholding Thee, O Lord, taking bread into Thy holy hands, lifting up Thine eyes to Heaven unto God the Father, having given thanks, Thou didst bless and break it, and gavest it unto Thy Holy Disciples: Grant it also unto us, Thy sinful servants.

items.section: Canon — Ode 9
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: СВѢТИ́ЛЕНЪ.
items.english_text: This is He, O most pure Virgin Birthgiver of God, worshiped in these Mysteries, Whom thou as Mother didst bear formerly in thy womb, holding Him in thine arms; Him do thou beseech for us, that He may save our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: This is He, O most pure Virgin Birthgiver of God, worshiped in these Mysteries, Whom thou as Mother didst bear formerly in thy womb, holding Him in thine arms; Him do thou beseech for us, that He may save our souls.

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "O Marvelous Wonder" (О дивное чудо)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Сїи́ е́сть прчⷭ҇тая Дв҃о Бц҃е, в си́хъ Та́йнахъ покланя́емый, его́же ты̀ носи́лаше пре́жде въ чре́вѣ Ма́тицы, поима̀ на рꙊкꙋ̀; Сего́же ѡ҆ на́съ молѝ, да сп҃се́тъ дꙊ́шы на́шя.
items.english_text: O marvelous wonder! The fountain of life is seen upon the Altar, and is given unto men for food! Rejoice, O Divine Church, adorned with the Bread of the Flesh of Christ; let us the faithful cry aloud, having John the Theologian as our choral leader: And the Word became Flesh, and dwelt among us; and we beheld His glory, as of the Only-begotten of the Father.

provenance.verbatim_source: O marvelous wonder! The fountain of life is seen upon the Altar, and is given unto men for food! Rejoice, O Divine Church, adorned with the Bread of the Flesh of Christ; let us the faithful cry aloud, having John the Theologian as our choral leader: And the Word became Flesh, and dwelt among us; and we beheld His glory, as of the Only-begotten of the Father.

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "O Marvelous Wonder" (О дивное чудо)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: НА ХВАЛИ́ТЕХЪ сті̑хиры, Гла́съ а҃. По: Ѡ ди́вное чꙊ́до!
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* O marvelous wonder! The true God, Who was prefigured in the manna, born of true God: having assumed human nature [continues to next leaf]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron 2:*
O marvelous wonder! The true God, Who was prefigured in the manna, born of true God: having assumed human nature [continues to next leaf]

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "O Marvelous Wonder" (О дивное чудо)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ ди́вное чꙊ́до! закла̀ премꙊ́дрость своя̀ же́ртвенная, и҆ черпа̀ въ ча́ши свое́й вїно̀, и҆ оу҆гото́ва свою̀ трапе́зꙊ, всѣ́хъ къ себѣ̀ созыва́ющи: прїиди́те яди́те моѝ хлѣ́бъ; и҆ пї́йте вїно̀ е́же черпа́хъ ва́мъ. Весели́теся Ца́рїе, и҆ вгрї́нте сты́телїе; и҆ Сло́во Пло́ть бы́сть, и҆ всели́ся въ ны̀, и҆ ви́дѣхомъ сла́вꙊ его̀, я҆́ко Є҆диноро́днаго ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* O marvelous wonder! Wisdom hath slain her sacrifices, and mingled her wine in her cup, and prepared her table, calling all unto herself: Come, eat of my bread, and drink the wine which I have mingled for you. Rejoice, ye kings, and leap for joy, ye hierarchs: And the Word became Flesh, and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, as of the Only-begotten of the Father.

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron 3:*
O marvelous wonder! Wisdom hath slain her sacrifices, and mingled her wine in her cup, and prepared her table, calling all unto herself: Come, eat of my bread, and drink the wine which I have mingled for you. Rejoice, ye kings, and leap for joy, ye hierarchs: And the Word became Flesh, and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, as of the Only-begotten of the Father.

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "O Marvelous Wonder" (О дивное чудо)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ ди́вное чꙊ́до! и҆́же на горѣ̀ Сїна́йстей съ Мѡѷсе́ѡмъ глаго́лый во кꙊпинѣ̀ неѡпали́мой, и҆ скрижа́ли зако́нныхъ написа́вый: его́же гла́съ гро́ма, трꙊ́бъ и҆ мо́лнїй оу҆страшѝ Сны̀ І҆илевы: проще́дшыя мо́ре послѣ́дꙊ, се́й дне́сь бл҃го́стно въ хлѣ́бѣ оу҆таи́ся, и҆ въ снѣ́дь подава́ется всѣ̑мъ; А҆́гнецъ Бг҃ъ, и҆ Сп҃си́тель.
items.english_text: *Sticheron 4:* O marvelous wonder! He Who on Mount Sinai spake with Moses in the unburnt bush, and wrote the tablets of the Law; Whose voice of thunder, trumpets, and lightnings terrified the sons of Israel, who had passed through the sea of old: the Same today graciously hides Himself in bread, and is given as food unto all: the Lamb, God, and Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sticheron 4:*
O marvelous wonder! He Who on Mount Sinai spake with Moses in the unburnt bush, and wrote the tablets of the Law; Whose voice of thunder, trumpets, and lightnings terrified the sons of Israel, who had passed through the sea of old: the Same today graciously hides Himself in bread, and is given as food unto all: the Lamb, God, and Savior!

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "O Marvelous Wonder" (О дивное чудо)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: А҆́зъ е́смь Хлѣ́бъ живо́тный, Хлѣ́бъ соше́дый с Нб҃сѐ, речѐ Гдⷭ҇ь ко прише́дшымъ к немꙊ̀ І҆ꙋде́ѡмъ: а҆́ще не снѣ́сте Пло́ти Сн҃а Чл҃вѣ́ческаго, и҆ не пїе́те Кро́ве его̀, живота̀ не и҆́мате в себѣ̀: я҆ды́й мою̀ Пло́ть, и҆ пїя́й мою̀ Кро́вь, и҆́матъ живо́тъ вѣ́чный, и҆ а҆́зъ воскрешꙊ̀ его̀ въ послѣ́дный де́нь.
items.english_text: I am the Living Bread, the Bread That came down from Heaven, said the Lord unto the Jews who came to Him: Except ye eat the Flesh of the Son of Man, and drink His Blood, ye have no life in you. Whoso eats My Flesh and drinks My Blood hath eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

provenance.verbatim_source: I am the Living Bread, the Bread That came down from Heaven, said the Lord unto the Jews who came to Him: Except ye eat the Flesh of the Son of Man, and drink His Blood, ye have no life in you. Whoso eats My Flesh and drinks My Blood hath eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Па́мять сотвори́лъ е́сть чꙊде́съ свои́хъ Гдⷭ҇ь, мл҃ти своея̀ ра́ди и҆ бл҃гоꙋтро́бїя, в си́хъ Та́йнахъ Пло́ти и҆ Кро́ви своея̀, Пло́ть свою̀ дая̀ въ снѣ́дь и҆ Кро́вь въ пи́тїе, со велелѣ́пїемъ: и҆ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇ня, и҆зыска́на въ всѣ́хъ во́ляхъ є҆гѡ̀, ст҃о и҆ стра́шно И҆́мя є҆гѡ̀, є҆́же е́сть па́че вся́каго и҆́мени; да ѡ҆ И҆́мени І҆и҃сово́мъ вся́ко колѣ́но покланя́ется, нб҃ныхъ и҆ земны́хъ и҆ преиспо́дныхъ.
items.english_text: The Lord hath made a memorial of His wonders, for the sake of His mercy and tender compassion, in these Mysteries of His Flesh and Blood, giving His Flesh for food and His Blood for drink with majesty; and the works of the Lord are sought out in all His will; holy and awesome is His Name, which is above every name, that at the Name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things on earth, and things under the earth.[^14]

provenance.verbatim_source: The Lord hath made a memorial of His wonders, for the sake of His mercy and tender compassion, in these Mysteries of His Flesh and Blood, giving His Flesh for food and His Blood for drink with majesty; and the works of the Lord are sought out in all His will; holy and awesome is His Name, which is above every name, that at the Name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things on earth, and things under the earth.[^14]

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "O Marvelous Wonder" (О дивное чудо)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Та́иннѣй дне́сь ве́чери, и҆ Трапе́зѣ Бж҃е́ственнѣй, со стра́хомъ прибли́жимся вѣ́рнїи, хотя́ще вкꙊси́ти И҆сто́чника безсме́ртнаго, но тре́петъ и҆ стра́хъ на́съ прїе́млетъ, многи́хъ ра́ди грѣ́хъ на́шихъ, ѿни́хже тобо́ю ѡ҆чи́ститися жела́емъ, моли́твами Бц҃ы нашея̀ Влⷣцы.
items.english_text: Today let us the faithful draw near with fear unto the Mystical Supper and the Divine Table, desiring to taste of the Immortal Fountain; yet trembling and fear take hold of us because of our many sins, from which through Thee we desire to be cleansed, by the prayers of the Birthgiver of God, our Sovereign Lady.

provenance.verbatim_source: Today let us the faithful draw near with fear unto the Mystical Supper and the Divine Table, desiring to taste of the Immortal Fountain; yet trembling and fear take hold of us because of our many sins, from which through Thee we desire to be cleansed, by the prayers of the Birthgiver of God, our Sovereign Lady.

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "O Marvelous Wonder" (О дивное чудо)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: И҆́нѣ: Богоро́: Гла́съ то́йже. Бг҃оже без̾ сѣ́мени роди́ла есѝ Прчⷭ҇таа Дв҃о, Се́й неневи́тно дне́сь, на престо́лѣ пра́зденственно зри́телся, и҆ въ снѣ́дь вѣ́рнымъ дае́тся; А҆́ггли со тре́петомъ, и҆ чл҃вѣ́цы я҆́ко Бг҃Ꙋ и҆́стиннꙊ покланя́ются, є҆го́же Ма́терными си мл҃твами оу҆молѝ, я҆́ко да не ѡ҆пали́тъ на́съ грѣ́хъ ра́ди на́шихъ: но поми́лꙊетъ и҆ сп҃се́тъ дꙊ́шы на́ша.
items.english_text: I am the Living Bread That came down from Heaven; if any man eat of this bread, he shall not die, but shall live unto ages; and the bread that I will give is My incorruptible Flesh, which I gave for the life of the world: I am the Living Bread, the Bread coming down from Heaven; if any man eat of it, he shall not die, but hath eternal life.

provenance.verbatim_source: I am the Living Bread That came down from Heaven; if any man eat of this bread, he shall not die, but shall live unto ages; and the bread that I will give is My incorruptible Flesh, which I gave for the life of the world: I am the Living Bread, the Bread coming down from Heaven; if any man eat of it, he shall not die, but hath eternal life.

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "O Marvelous Wonder" (О дивное чудо)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: Пр[е]стѣ́й Та́инѣ Еv́харї́стїи. На стїхо́внахъ: Гла́съ в҃. Подо́бенъ: До́ме Є҆vфра́ѳовъ: На та́инной вече́ри, Хрⷭ҇то́съ Бг҃ъ да́лъ е́сть а҆́пⷭ҇ломъ я́сти Пло́ть свою̀ Бж҃твеннꙊю, во и҆сцѣле́нїе дꙊ́шъ и҆ тѣ́лъ. Стїхъ. Оу҆гото́валъ есѝ трапе́зꙊ Пред стꙊжа́ющими мѝ. ПристꙊпи́те всѝ, не ко Сїна́истей горѣ̀, но ко Бг҃Ꙋ вы́шнемꙊ в си́хъ Та́йнахъ оу҆тае́нномꙊ, Хрⷭ҇тꙊ̀ Бг҃Ꙋ на́шемꙊ. Стїхъ. Гдⷭ҇ь пасе́тъ мя̀ и҆ ничто́же мя̀ лиши́тъ. Дае́тся Хрⷭ҇то́съ всѣ́мъ въ снѣ́дь грѣ́шнымъ; хлѣ́бъ творя̀ Тѣ́ло, и҆ вї́но въ Кро́вь, Бж҃е́ственное претваря́ющи. Сла́ва: Гла́съ и҆ По: то́й: Хва́лимъ тя̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ Сп҃се на́шъ бл҃гі́и: и҆́же Кро́вь твою̀, и҆злїя́лъ есѝ, сп҃се́нїя чл҃вѣ́ческаго. И҆ ны́нѣ: то́й: Бц҃е Дв҃о Марї́е, молѝ не тебѐ ро́ждшагося Хрⷭ҇та̀, да досто́йныхъ на́съ сотвори́тъ, прича́стниками бы́ти. По ны́нѣ ѿпꙊща́еши: Трⷭ҇тое: и҆ по Ѻ҆́че на́шъ: Тро́: Прáз:
items.english_text: The God Whom without seed thou didst bear, O Most Pure Virgin, the Same today ineffably[^15] is seen festively upon the Altar, and is given unto the faithful for food; the angels with trembling and men as unto the true God bow down before Him: Whom do thou beseech with maternal prayers, that He consume us not because of our sins, but have mercy and save our souls.

provenance.verbatim_source: The God Whom without seed thou didst bear, O Most Pure Virgin, the Same today ineffably[^15] is seen festively upon the Altar, and is given unto the faithful for food; the angels with trembling and men as unto the true God bow down before Him: Whom do thou beseech with maternal prayers, that He consume us not because of our sins, but have mercy and save our souls.

items.section: At the Praises, Stichera, Tone 1, Podoben: "O Marvelous Wonder" (О дивное чудо)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: В Пѧто́къ на Оу҆́трени, Тропа́рь Прáз: и҆ стѡ́мꙊ: Сѣда́: по а҃. Каѳи́: Прáз: по в҃. дню̀: Кано́: Прáз: и҆ стѡ́мꙊ: по г҃. Пѣ́сны. Кон: Прáз: по ѕ҃. Кон: стѡ́мꙊ. Свѣти́: дню̀. Сла́ва: Прáз: И҆ ны́нѣ: та́же. На стїхо́вныхъ. Прáз: Стїхи̑, Гла́съ ѕ҃. Подо: Тридне́вно воскре́слъ есѝ. Та́йна сїя̀ вели́кая и҆ стра́шная е́сть, в не́йже Созда́телъ Бг҃ъ сокрове́нъ пребыва́етъ, со Бж҃тво́мъ и҆ Пло́тїю и҆ дꙊше́ю, мл҃ти ра́ди ро́да чл҃вѣ́ческаго, СемꙊ̀ всѝ кланя́емся, я҆́кѡ Бг҃Ꙋ, и҆ сп҃сꙊ дꙊша́мъ на́шымъ. Стїхъ. Что возда́мъ Гдⷭ҇еви ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ, я҆́же воздаде́ ми. Ѡ чꙊ́до пресла́вное! я҆́ко Бг҃ъ невмѣсти́мыи пе́рвѣе, въ чре́вѣ Дв҃и́чїй вмѣще́нъ, дне́сь же въ крꙊпи́ци ма́лой хлѣ́ба зако́паный, ѿ чл҃вѣ́къ поклоне́нїе пра́зденственно прїе́млетъ: є҆го́же мы̀ съ а҆́ггли и҆ а҆рха́ггли воспое́мъ, Сп҃си́теля дꙊша́мъ на́шымъ. Стї. Ча́шꙊ сп҃се́нїя прїимꙊ̀, и҆ И҆́мя Гдⷭ҇не призовꙊ̀. Ты̀ есѝ А҆рхїере́й по чи́нꙊ Мелхїседе́ковꙊ, принося́й Бг҃Ꙋ Ѻ҆ц҃Ꙋ̀ хлѣ́бъ и҆ вїно̀ же́ртвꙊ Себѐ, грѣ́хъ ра́ди на́шихъ; Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е Сп҃се [продолженіе на слѣд. листѣ]
items.english_text: Who is so great a god as our God? Thou art the God Who doest wonders (Ps. 76:14).

provenance.verbatim_source: Who is so great a god as our God? Thou art the God Who doest wonders (Ps. 76:14).

Та́йна сїя̀ вели́кая и҆ стра́шная е́сть, в не́йже Созда́телъ Бг҃ъ сокрове́нъ пребыва́етъ, со Бж҃тво́мъ и҆ Пло́тїю и҆ дꙊше́ю, мл҃ти ра́ди ро́да чл҃вѣ́ческаго, СемꙊ̀ всѝ кланя́емся, я҆́кѡ Бг҃Ꙋ, и҆ сп҃сꙊ дꙊша́мъ на́шымъ. Стїхъ. Что возда́мъ Гдⷭ҇еви ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ, я҆́же воздаде́ ми. Ѡ чꙊ́до пресла́вное! я҆́ко Бг҃ъ невмѣсти́мыи пе́рвѣе, въ чре́вѣ Дв҃и́чїй вмѣще́нъ, дне́сь же въ крꙊпи́ци ма́лой хлѣ́ба зако́паный, ѿ чл҃вѣ́къ поклоне́нїе пра́зденственно прїе́млетъ: є҆го́же мы̀ съ а҆́ггли и҆ а҆рха́ггли воспое́мъ, Сп҃си́теля дꙊша́мъ на́шымъ. Стї. Ча́шꙊ сп҃се́нїя прїимꙊ̀, и҆ И҆́мя Гдⷭ҇не призовꙊ̀. Ты̀ есѝ А҆рхїере́й по чи́нꙊ Мелхїседе́ковꙊ, принося́й Бг҃Ꙋ Ѻ҆ц҃Ꙋ̀ хлѣ́бъ и҆ вїно̀ же́ртвꙊ Себѐ, грѣ́хъ ра́ди на́шихъ; Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е Сп҃се [продолженіе на слѣд. листѣ]

items.slavonic_text: Я҆дꙊ́щымъ Оу҆ченико́мъ на та́инной вече́ри: прїе́мъ І҆и҃съ хлѣ́бъ в рꙊ́цѣ своѝ; ѻ҆́чи же своѝ возве́дъ на Нб҃о, бл҃гвѝ, преломѝ, дае́тъ Оу҆ченико́мъ свои̑мъ гла́: прїими́те и҆ яди́те сїѐ е́сть Тѣ́ло моѐ, е́же за вы̀ ломи́мое во ѡ҆ставле́нїе грѣхѡ́въ и҆ въ жи́знь вѣ́чнꙊю.

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ г҃. Прїиди́те всѝ концы̀ земны́я и҆ въ хра́мъ Гдⷭ҇нь ста́вше дне́сь: припадѐмъ на лица̀ землѝ со смире́нїемъ; я҆́коже же ви́дѣ І҆ѡа́ннъ Бг҃осло́въ Ста́рца два́десятъ и҆ четы́ры, припада́юща пре сѣдя́щымъ на Престо́лѣ, и҆ живꙊ́щымъ во вѣ́ки вѣкѡ́въ; Се́й бо бы́сть А҆́гнецъ Бж҃їи на Престо́лѣ сѣдя́щъ, є҆го́же зри́мъ дне́сь въ прⷭ҇ты́хъ Та́йнахъ неви́димаго, види́мъ же е́сть ѡ҆чи́щеныхъ вѣ́рою; є҆го́же я҆́ко Бг҃а и҆ Сло́ва вочл҃вѣ́чшася и҆сповѣ́дꙊюще, со стра́хомъ и҆ тре́петомъ, є҆мꙊ̀ покланя́емъся.
items.english_text: Isaac the Patriarch giving a blessing unto his son Jacob, confirmed him with abundance of wheat and wine, and unto this blessing of the Patriarch he joined also the filiation of the firstborn.[^17] In like manner also did our Savior Christ the Lord, giving unto us supernatural Bread, and the wine of His true Flesh; for taking bread into His Divine hands He said: Take, eat, this is My Body; drink of the cup, for this is My Blood, shed for the whole world.

provenance.verbatim_source: Isaac the Patriarch giving a blessing unto his son Jacob, confirmed him with abundance of wheat and wine, and unto this blessing of the Patriarch he joined also the filiation of the firstborn.[^17] In like manner also did our Savior Christ the Lord, giving unto us supernatural Bread, and the wine of His true Flesh; for taking bread into His Divine hands He said: Take, eat, this is My Body; drink of the cup, for this is My Blood, shed for the whole world.

items.section: Stichera of the Feast, 3, Tone 5, Idiomela

items.slavonic_text: По Свѣ́те ти́хїй: Прокі́менъ днѐ. На Стїхо́внахъ: Стїхи̑: Гла́са є҃, Самогла́сны: Воскли́кнѣте лю́дїе чл҃вѣколю́бцꙊ Бг҃Ꙋ, я҆́ко сотвори́ намъ вели́чїе си́лный, на та́иннѣй вече́ри свое́й; пода́юще всѣ́мъ хлѣ́бъ Нб҃ный, въ сп҃се́нїе дꙊша́мъ на́шимъ. Стї́. Па́мять сотвори́лъ е́сть чꙊде́съ свои́хъ, мл҃тивъ и҆ ще́дръ Гдⷭ҇ь. Вся̀ земля̀ да покло́нится Бг҃Ꙋ, в си́хъ Та́йнахъ живꙊ, бл҃годаря́ще мл҃рдїе є҆го́: я҆́ко хлѣ́бъ Преесте́ственный съ Нб҃сѐ, бра́шно дае́тъ возлю́бленнымъ свои̑мъ, и҆́хже и҆скꙊпи́лъ е́сть Кро́вїю. Стї́. И҆збавлѐнїе посла̀ Гдⷭ҇ь лю́демъ свои̑мъ. ВкꙊси́те и҆ оу҆ви́дите, я҆́ко бл҃гъ Гдⷭ҇ь, и҆́же на та́инной вече́ри, Пло́ть свою̀ дае́тъ Оу҆́чникомъ, и҆ всѣ́мъ вѣ́рны въ снѣ́дь, и҆ въ сп҃се́нїе вѣ́чное. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́са ѕ҃. А҆́зъ е́смь хлѣ́бъ живо́тный, соше́дый съ Нб҃сѐ, да а҆́ще кто̀ снѣ́сть ѿ него̀, не оу҆́мретъ, но жи́въ бꙊ́детъ въ вѣ́ки, и҆ хлѣ́бъ є҆го́же а҆́зъ да́мъ, и҆́стиннаа Пло́ть мо́я е́сть, ю́же а҆́зъ да́мъ за живо́тъ мі́ра, а҆́зъ е́смь хлѣ́бъ живо́тный, хлѣ́бъ схо́дяй съ Нб҃сѐ, да а҆́ще кто̀ ѿ него̀ я́стъ, не оу҆́мретъ, но и҆́матъ живо́тъ вѣ́чный.
items.english_text: As a deer longs for the fountains of water, so my soul longs for Thee, O God (Ps. 41:2), Who hast given us Thy Flesh for food, and feedest us who hunger with Divine Bread, and givest drink unto our thirsting souls with the wine of Thy Most Pure Blood; therefore today bowing down festively unto Thee, Christ our God, Who becamest man, Who didst suffer on the Cross, and diedst for the sake of our salvation, Who rosest on the third day, ascendedst into Heaven, and sittest at the right hand of the Father: before Thee we fall down, and with compunction cry aloud: Save us, for the sake of Thy tender mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: As a deer longs for the fountains of water, so my soul longs for Thee, O God (Ps. 41:2), Who hast given us Thy Flesh for food, and feedest us who hunger with Divine Bread, and givest drink unto our thirsting souls with the wine of Thy Most Pure Blood; therefore today bowing down festively unto Thee, Christ our God, Who becamest man, Who didst suffer on the Cross, and diedst for the sake of our salvation, Who rosest on the third day, ascendedst into Heaven, and sittest at the right hand of the Father: before Thee we fall down, and with compunction cry aloud: Save us, for the sake of Thy tender mercy!

items.slavonic_text: В СꙊББО́ТꙊ на Оу҆́трени: на Стїхо́внахъ стїхи̑, Гла́са а҃. По: Не́бнымъ чино́: Весели́ся дне́сь Цр҃кви Хрⷭ҇то́ва, пра́зденственно покланя́ющися Хрⷭ҇тꙊ̀ Бг҃Ꙋ, Пло́тїю ѿ Дв҃ы ро́ждшемꙊся, и҆ в Та́йнахъ хлѣ́ба сокрове́нномꙊ, и҆ въ снѣ́дь чл҃вѣ́комъ даю́щемꙊся, и҆ сп҃саю́щемꙊ дꙊ́шы на́ша. Стї́. Ѡ҆дождѝ и҆̀мъ ма́ннꙊ я́сти, и҆ Хлѣ́бъ Нб҃ный дадѐ и҆̀мъ. [продолженіе на слѣд. листѣ]
items.english_text: While the disciples were eating at the Mystical Supper, Jesus took bread into His hands, and lifting up His eyes to Heaven, blessed, brake, and gave it unto His disciples, saying: Take, eat, this is My Body, which is broken for you for the remission of sins and unto eternal life.

provenance.verbatim_source: While the disciples were eating at the Mystical Supper, Jesus took bread into His hands, and lifting up His eyes to Heaven, blessed, brake, and gave it unto His disciples, saying: Take, eat, this is My Body, which is broken for you for the remission of sins and unto eternal life.

items.english_text: Come, all ye ends of the earth, and standing today in the temple of the Lord, let us fall down upon the face of the earth with humility; even as John the Theologian saw the four and twenty elders falling down before Him Who sits on the Throne and Who lives unto ages of ages; for this was the Lamb of God sitting on the Throne, Whom today we behold invisible in the Holy Mysteries, yet visible unto them that are purified by faith; Whom confessing as God and the Word incarnate, with fear and trembling we worship Him.[^18]

Бг҃ооте́цъ Дв҃дъ провожда̀ Кївѡ́тъ ѿ до́мꙊ Ѻ҆ведѐдо́ма, въ гра́дъ сво́й игра́юще въ трꙊ́бы, въ тꙊмпа́ны и҆ кѵмва́лы, є҆́нже лю́дїе провожда́хꙊ Кївѡ́тъ со весе́лїемъ, но чре́зъ гра́дъ и҆гва́нъ, Кївѡ́тъ сѣне́й знаме́нїе Кївѡ́та ст҃а́я сты́хъ, Тѣ́ла и҆ Кро́ве Хрⷭ҇та̀ на́шего, и҆́же дне́сь ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ покланя́емыи; є҆мꙊ́же и҆ мы̀ покланя́ющеся, я҆́кѡ Бг҃Ꙋ и҆ Зижди́телю всѣхъ, мо́лимся, да сп҃се́тъ дꙊ́шы на́ша. На Стїхо́внахъ стїхи̑: Гла́съ в҃. Подо́: До́ме Є҆vфра́ѳовъ: Бл҃гвѝ І҆саа́къ І҆а́кѡва гла́: да да́стъ ты Бг҃ъ ѿ росы̀ Нб҃ныя, и҆ ѿ тꙊ́ка земна́го ѡ҆би́лїе пшени́цы и҆ вїна̀, Се́бо та́на бы́сть Тѣ́ла и҆ Кро́ви Гдⷭ҇ня, и҆ преднарече́тся. Стїхъ. Гдⷭ҇ь пасе́тъ мя̀, и҆ ничто́же мя̀ лиши́тъ. Непроси́ше І҆са́въ бл҃гвенїя Ѻ҆тца̀, нѣ́ст ли ѡ҆ста́ло бл҃гослове́нїа и҆ мнѣ̀ ѽ́че? пшени́цею и҆ вїно́мъ оу҆тверди́хъ є҆гѡ̀ [продолженіе на слѣд. листѣ]

items.english_text: On the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples said unto Jesus: Lord, where wilt Thou that we prepare for Thee to eat the Passover? And He said: Go ye into the city before you, and entering into the house say: The Teacher says: With thee will I keep the Passover with My disciples. And they did as they were commanded, and prepared the Passover; and as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and having given thanks, blessed and brake it, and gave it unto the disciples, saying: Take, eat, this is My Body; drink of it, this is My Blood, for the remission of sins.

items.english_text: David the forefather of God accompanied the Ark from the house of Obed-edom into his own city, playing upon trumpets, timbrels, and cymbals, where the people accompanied the Ark with rejoicing; but as it was borne through the city, the Ark of the shadows was a prefiguring of the Ark of the Holy of Holies, the Body and Blood of our Christ, Who today is worshiped by all; Whom we also worshiping as God and Creator of all, pray that He save our souls.

items.english_text: The Lord fed His disciples with heavenly food; before His Passion He gave them the bread of angels, surpassing the marvelous manna: Your fathers, said the Lord, ate manna in the wilderness, and died; this is the Bread coming down from Heaven, that if any man eat of it, he shall not die, but shall live unto ages: of Which do Thou account us also now worthy to partake, through the prayers of Thy Mother of God.

Самогла́: Въ пе́рвый де́нь ѡ҆прѣсно́чны, гла́хꙊ Оу҆́чницы къ І҆и҃сови: Гдⷭ҇и, гдѣ̀ хо́щеши оу҆гото́влемъ тѝ я́сти Па́схꙊ? Ѻ҆́нъ же речѐ: и҆дѣ́те въ преднюю ве́сь, и҆ влѣ́зше въ до́мꙊ рече́те: Оу҆чи́тель гле́тъ: оу҆ тебѐ сотворю̀ Па́схꙊ со Оу҆́чники мои́ми; и҆ сотвори́ша повелѣ́нное, оу҆гото́ваша Па́схꙊ; я҆дꙊ́щымъ же и҆́мъ, прїе́мъ І҆и҃съ хлѣ́бъ, бл҃годари́въ, бл҃гвивъ, и҆ преломи́въ, дая́ше Оу҆́чникомъ гла́: прїими́те и҆ яди́те сїѐ е́сть Тѣ́ло моѐ, пи́йте ѿ нея̀, Сїя́ е́сть Кро́вь моя̀, въ ѡ҆ставле́нїе грѣхо́въ. Бг҃ооте́цъ Дв҃дъ провожда̀ Кївѡ́тъ ѿ до́мꙊ Ѻ҆ведѐдо́ма, въ гра́дъ сво́й игра́юще въ трꙊ́бы, въ тꙊмпа́ны и҆ кѵмва́лы, є҆́нже лю́дїе провожда́хꙊ Кївѡ́тъ со весе́лїемъ, но чре́зъ гра́дъ и҆гва́нъ, Кївѡ́тъ сѣне́й знаме́нїе Кївѡ́та ст҃а́я сты́хъ, Тѣ́ла и҆ Кро́ве Хрⷭ҇та̀ на́шего, и҆́же дне́сь ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ покланя́емыи; є҆мꙊ́же и҆ мы̀ покланя́ющеся, я҆́кѡ Бг҃Ꙋ и҆ Зижди́телю всѣхъ, мо́лимся, да сп҃се́тъ дꙊ́шы на́ша. Напита̀ Гдⷭ҇ь Оу҆́чники своя̀ бра́шномъ нб҃нымъ, пре́жде стра́сти даетъ и҆̀мъ хлѣ́бъ а҆́гглскїи, па́че ма́нны преди́вныя: Ѻ҆тцы̀ ва́ши, речѐ Гдⷭ҇ь, я҆до́ша ма́ннꙊ въ пꙊсты́ни и҆ оу҆мро́ша, Се́й е́сть хлѣ́бъ схо́дяй съ Нб҃сѐ, да а҆́ще кто̀ ѿ негѡ̀ я҆́стъ не оу҆́мретъ, но жи́въ бꙊ́детъ во вѣ́ки: є҆го́же и҆ на́съ нн҃ѣ сподо́би причасти́тися, мл҃твами твоея̀ ра́ди Бг҃ома́тере. Сла́: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ г҃. Ѡ мꙊ́дрости предивнаа! ѽ мл҃ти къ на́мъ Бж҃їя неизглаго́ланнаа: како Бг҃ъ не то́кмо на́съ дѣ́ла чл҃вѣ́къ бы́сть, и҆ Бж҃тво̀ къ человѣ́чествꙊ сокры̀: но въ хлѣ́бѣ себѐ сама́го оу҆таѝ, и҆ чл҃вѣ́комъ въ снѣ́дь дадѐ: сла́ва твое́мꙊ Бж҃твенномꙊ бл҃гоꙋтро́бїю. На Стїхо́внахъ стїхи̑: Гла́съ в҃. Подо́: До́ме Є҆vфра́ѳовъ: Бл҃гвѝ І҆саа́къ І҆а́кѡва гла́: да да́стъ ты Бг҃ъ ѿ росы̀ Нб҃ныя, и҆ ѿ тꙊ́ка земна́го ѡ҆би́лїе пшени́цы и҆ вїна̀, Се́бо та́на бы́сть Тѣ́ла и҆ Кро́ви Гдⷭ҇ня, и҆ преднарече́тся. Стїхъ. Гдⷭ҇ь пасе́тъ мя̀, и҆ ничто́же мя̀ лиши́тъ. Непроси́ше І҆са́въ бл҃гвенїя Ѻ҆тца̀, нѣ́ст ли ѡ҆ста́ло бл҃гослове́нїа и҆ мнѣ̀ ѽ́че? пшени́цею и҆ вїно́мъ оу҆тверди́хъ є҆гѡ̀ [продолженіе на слѣд. листѣ]
items.english_text: Isaac blessed Jacob, saying: God give thee of the dew of heaven, and of the fatness of the earth, abundance of corn and wine (Gen. 27:28); for this was a mystery of the Body and Blood of the Lord, and was forenamed.

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera, Tone 2, Podoben: "O House of Ephratha" (До́ме Є҆vфра́ѳовъ)
items.season_or_tone: PART I: FESTAL OFFICES DECREED BY THE SYNOD OF ZAMOŚĆ
items.slavonic_text: СЛꙊ́ЖБА [продолженіе съ пред. листа:] є҆го̀, тебѣ́же что̀ сотворю̀ ча́до? речѐ Ѻ҆ц҃ъ къ сн҃Ꙋ своемꙊ̀ І҆са́вꙊ. Стї́хъ. Оу҆гото́валъ есѝ предомно́ю трапе́зꙊ, пред стꙊжа́ю: Нѣ́сть бл҃гвенїя, то́кмо въ Тѣ́лѣ и҆ Кро́ви Хрⷭ҇тово́й, я҆́же на́мъ да́лъ е́сть Хрⷭ҇то́съ Гдⷭ҇ь сама́го себѐ, въ ѡ҆чище́нїе грѣхо́въ на́шихъ. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ и҃. Се́й е́сть хлѣ́бъ соше́дый съ Нб҃се, да а҆́ще кто̀ ѿ него̀ я́стъ жи́въ бꙊ́детъ; возыва́ше І҆и҃съ гла́: а҆́ще кто̀ жа́ждетъ, да прїи́детъ ко мнѣ̀ и҆ пїе́тъ; и҆ рѣ́ки чре́ва є҆го́ и҆стекꙊ́тъ воды̀ жи́вїя; я҆ды́й мою̀ Пло́ть, и҆ пїя́й мою̀ Кро́вь, во мнѣ̀ пребыва́етъ и҆ а҆́зъ в не́мъ. В ПОНЕДѢ́ЛОКЪ НА ОУ҆́ТРЕНИ: НА СТЇХО́ВНАХЪ, Стїхи̑: Гла́съ д҃. Подо́: Я҆́ко до́бля въ мч҃ницехъ: Чл҃вѣколю́бче Сп҃сителю Хрⷭ҇тѐ, сп҃сенїя на́шего ра́ди соше́дый съ Нб҃съ; и҆ ѿ Мр҃їи Дв҃ы вочл҃вѣ́чивыйся, хотя́й во́лею и҆тѝ на сме́рть, сїю̀ Та́инꙊ Бж҃твеннꙊю оу҆ста́вилъ есѝ, дая́и себѐ въ снѣ́дь Оу҆́ченикомъ, и҆ всѣ́мъ вѣ́рнымъ: и҆́мже пода́ждь бл҃гть и҆ живо́тъ вѣ́чный. Стїхъ. И҆ ѡ҆дождѝ и҆̀мъ ма́ннꙊ я́сти, и҆ Хлѣ́бъ Нб҃ный дадѐ и҆̀мъ. А҆́зъ е́смъ хлѣ́бъ нб҃ный, речѐ Гдⷭ҇ь сїѡ́нѡмъ, Оу҆́чникомъ, соше́дый съ Нб҃се: а҆́зъ е́смъ хлѣ́бъ живо́тный, гряды́й ко мнѣ̀ не и҆́матъ вза́лкатися, и҆ вѣ́рꙊяй въ мя̀ не и҆́матъ вжажда́тися; а҆́ще бо кто̀ снѣ́стъ ѿ хлѣ́ба сего̀, жи́въ бꙊ́детъ во вѣ́ки, и҆ хлѣ́бъ є҆го́же а҆́зъ да́мъ, Пло́ть моя̀ е́сть, даю́щая причаща́ющымся живо́тъ вѣ́чный. Стї. Хлѣ́бъ а҆́гглскїй ядѐ чл҃къ, бра́шно посла̀ и҆̀мъ до сы́тїя. Зря́ще та́йнꙊ Пло́ти Бж҃твенныя, хлѣ́бъ Преесте́ственный, Бг҃Ꙋ воплоти́вшемся ѿ Дв҃ы Мр҃їи, со оу҆миле́нїемъ поклони́мся; се́бо е́сть А҆́гнецъ неѕло́бивый, взе́мляй грѣхѝ мі́ра, и҆ сп҃саяй дꙊ́шы на́ша. Сла́: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ в҃. Оу҆диви́ся вся̀ тва́рь Бж҃їемꙊ и҆змѣне́нїю стра́шномꙊ, ка́кѡ Бг҃ъ Нб҃си и҆ землѝ не ѡ҆б̾име́нный, въ ма́ннѣ и҆ части хлѣ́ба, ве́сь содержи́тъся, съ Бж҃твомъ Пло́тїю и҆ дꙊше́ю Бж҃е́ственною, Е҆го́же та́кѡ и҆сповѣ́дꙊюще, Бж҃е́ственномꙊ Тѣ́лꙊ Хв҃Ꙋ покланя́емся: я҆́ко да полꙊчи́мъ ѿ него̀ Ѻ҆́чее бл҃гвенїе. В ПОНЕДѢ́ЛОКЪ ВЕ́ЧЕРЪ, на Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ: Стїхи̑, Прáз: г҃. Гла́съ є҃. Самогла́: Сни́дѣте всѝ А҆́ггли Нб҃нїи, и҆ вся̀ Си́лы Бж҃їя, восхва́лимъ с на́ми Бг҃а вочл҃вѣ́чшагося; и҆́же мл҃ти ра́ди ро́да чл҃вѣ́ча, неи́счетною мꙊ́дростїю свое́ю Бж҃їею, сама́го себѐ в Та́йнахъ хлѣ́ба зако́па; и҆ въ пи́щꙊ чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ ѡ҆ста́ви; є҆го́же я҆́ко Бг҃а дне́сь пра́зденственно воспое́мъ гля́ще: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ есѝ Бж҃е, сла́ва бл҃гоꙋтро́бїю твое́мꙊ. Прїиди́те всѝ концѝ земні́и, Преначⷭ҇тнѣ́йшое Тѣ́ло Бж҃їе оу҆блажи́мъ: є҆́же за ны̀ и҆ грѣ́хъ ра́ди на́шихъ ломи́мое, и҆ на сме́рть Крⷭ҇тно́ю данное е́стъ, по воскрⷭ҇нїиже на Нб҃са вознесе́нно, ѡ҆деснꙊ́ю Бг҃а Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ посажде́нно въ сла́вѣ, и҆ в си́хъ Та́йнахъ на землѝ то́жде вѣ́рнымъ ѡ҆ста́вленно; є҆́же мы̀ всѝ земноро́дні́и на лицѐ землѝ припада́юще, со оу҆миле́нїемъ восхваля́емъ. Прїиди́те пра́зднолюбныхъ собо́ры, прїиди́те и҆ ли́къ соста́вимъ, прїиди́те вѣнча́емъ Че́рковь Хрⷭ҇то́вꙊ, дне́сь пра́зденственно оу҆краше́ннꙊю; в не́йже Хлѣ́бъ преесте́ственный Хрⷭ҇то́съ зри́тся; и҆ чл҃вѣ́комъ въ снѣ́дь дае́тся: є҆мꙊ́же всѝ вѣ́рні́и со стра́хомъ и҆ весе́лїемъ покланя́емся, и҆ съ ли́ки Си́лъ Нб҃ныхъ восхва́лимъ гля́ще: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ есѝ А҆́гнче Бж҃їй, взе́мляй грѣхѝ мі́ра. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ то́йже. Прїиди́те вся̀ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇ня, Гдⷭ҇а с на́ми воспо́йте, и҆́же здѣ̀ е́стъ покланя́емый: бл҃гвѣ́те со́лнце мц҃ъ и҆ ѕвѣ́зды; Ѻ҆́гнь, мо́ре, возду́хъ, ѻ҆́блаци и҆ вся̀ тва́рь; я҆́ко ѕѣло̀ и҆ до кон- [продолженіе на слѣд. листѣ]
items.english_text: There is no blessing, save in the Body and Blood of Christ, which Christ the Lord hath given us, even Himself, for the cleansing of our sins.

provenance.verbatim_source: There is no blessing, save in the Body and Blood of Christ, which Christ the Lord hath given us, even Himself, for the cleansing of our sins.

Се́й е́сть хлѣ́бъ соше́дый съ Нб҃се, да а҆́ще кто̀ ѿ него̀ я́стъ жи́въ бꙊ́детъ; возыва́ше І҆и҃съ гла́: а҆́ще кто̀ жа́ждетъ, да прїи́детъ ко мнѣ̀ и҆ пїе́тъ; и҆ рѣ́ки чре́ва є҆го́ и҆стекꙊ́тъ воды̀ жи́вїя; я҆ды́й мою̀ Пло́ть, и҆ пїя́й мою̀ Кро́вь, во мнѣ̀ пребыва́етъ и҆ а҆́зъ в не́мъ. В ПОНЕДѢ́ЛОКЪ НА ОУ҆́ТРЕНИ: НА СТЇХО́ВНАХЪ, Стїхи̑: Гла́съ д҃. Подо́: Я҆́ко до́бля въ мч҃ницехъ: Чл҃вѣколю́бче Сп҃сителю Хрⷭ҇тѐ, сп҃сенїя на́шего ра́ди соше́дый съ Нб҃съ; и҆ ѿ Мр҃їи Дв҃ы вочл҃вѣ́чивыйся, хотя́й во́лею и҆тѝ на сме́рть, сїю̀ Та́инꙊ Бж҃твеннꙊю оу҆ста́вилъ есѝ, дая́и себѐ въ снѣ́дь Оу҆́ченикомъ, и҆ всѣ́мъ вѣ́рнымъ: и҆́мже пода́ждь бл҃гть и҆ живо́тъ вѣ́чный. Стїхъ. И҆ ѡ҆дождѝ и҆̀мъ ма́ннꙊ я́сти, и҆ Хлѣ́бъ Нб҃ный дадѐ и҆̀мъ. А҆́зъ е́смъ хлѣ́бъ нб҃ный, речѐ Гдⷭ҇ь сїѡ́нѡмъ, Оу҆́чникомъ, соше́дый съ Нб҃се: а҆́зъ е́смъ хлѣ́бъ живо́тный, гряды́й ко мнѣ̀ не и҆́матъ вза́лкатися, и҆ вѣ́рꙊяй въ мя̀ не и҆́матъ вжажда́тися; а҆́ще бо кто̀ снѣ́стъ ѿ хлѣ́ба сего̀, жи́въ бꙊ́детъ во вѣ́ки, и҆ хлѣ́бъ є҆го́же а҆́зъ да́мъ, Пло́ть моя̀ е́сть, даю́щая причаща́ющымся живо́тъ вѣ́чный. Стї. Хлѣ́бъ а҆́гглскїй ядѐ чл҃къ, бра́шно посла̀ и҆̀мъ до сы́тїя. Зря́ще та́йнꙊ Пло́ти Бж҃твенныя, хлѣ́бъ Преесте́ственный, Бг҃Ꙋ воплоти́вшемся ѿ Дв҃ы Мр҃їи, со оу҆миле́нїемъ поклони́мся; се́бо е́сть А҆́гнецъ неѕло́бивый, взе́мляй грѣхѝ мі́ра, и҆ сп҃саяй дꙊ́шы на́ша. Сла́: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ в҃. Оу҆диви́ся вся̀ тва́рь Бж҃їемꙊ и҆змѣне́нїю стра́шномꙊ, ка́кѡ Бг҃ъ Нб҃си и҆ землѝ не ѡ҆б̾име́нный, въ ма́ннѣ и҆ части хлѣ́ба, ве́сь содержи́тъся, съ Бж҃твомъ Пло́тїю и҆ дꙊше́ю Бж҃е́ственною, Е҆го́же та́кѡ и҆сповѣ́дꙊюще, Бж҃е́ственномꙊ Тѣ́лꙊ Хв҃Ꙋ покланя́емся: я҆́ко да полꙊчи́мъ ѿ него̀ Ѻ҆́чее бл҃гвенїе. В ПОНЕДѢ́ЛОКЪ ВЕ́ЧЕРЪ, на Гдⷭ҇и воззва́хъ: Стїхи̑, Прáз: г҃. Гла́съ є҃. Самогла́: Сни́дѣте всѝ А҆́ггли Нб҃нїи, и҆ вся̀ Си́лы Бж҃їя, восхва́лимъ с на́ми Бг҃а вочл҃вѣ́чшагося; и҆́же мл҃ти ра́ди ро́да чл҃вѣ́ча, неи́счетною мꙊ́дростїю свое́ю Бж҃їею, сама́го себѐ в Та́йнахъ хлѣ́ба зако́па; и҆ въ пи́щꙊ чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ ѡ҆ста́ви; є҆го́же я҆́ко Бг҃а дне́сь пра́зденственно воспое́мъ гля́ще: ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ есѝ Бж҃е, сла́ва бл҃гоꙋтро́бїю твое́мꙊ. Прїиди́те всѝ концѝ земні́и, Преначⷭ҇тнѣ́йшое Тѣ́ло Бж҃їе оу҆блажи́мъ: є҆́же за ны̀ и҆ грѣ́хъ ра́ди на́шихъ ломи́мое, и҆ на сме́рть Крⷭ҇тно́ю данное е́стъ, по воскрⷭ҇нїиже на Нб҃са вознесе́нно, ѡ҆деснꙊ́ю Бг҃а Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ посажде́нно въ сла́вѣ, и҆ в си́хъ Та́йнахъ на землѝ то́жде вѣ́рнымъ ѡ҆ста́вленно; є҆́же мы̀ всѝ земноро́дні́и на лицѐ землѝ припада́юще, со оу҆миле́нїемъ восхваля́емъ. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ то́йже. Прїиди́те вся̀ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇ня, Гдⷭ҇а с на́ми воспо́йте, и҆́же здѣ̀ е́стъ покланя́емый: бл҃гвѣ́те со́лнце мц҃ъ и҆ ѕвѣ́зды; Ѻ҆́гнь, мо́ре, возду́хъ, ѻ҆́блаци и҆ вся̀ тва́рь; я҆́ко ѕѣло̀ и҆ до кон- [продолженіе на слѣд. листѣ]
items.english_text: This is the Bread That came down from Heaven, that if any man eat of it, he shall live; Jesus cried aloud, saying: If any man thirst, let him come unto Me and drink; and out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water (John 7:37–38); he that eats My Flesh and drinks My Blood abides in Me, and I in him.

items.english_text: I am the Heavenly Bread, said the Lord unto His disciples on Zion, Who came down from Heaven: I am the Living Bread; he that comes to Me shall not hunger, and he that believes in Me shall not thirst; for if any man eat of this Bread, he shall live unto ages, and the Bread that I will give is My Flesh, which gives eternal life unto them that partake.

items.english_text: All creation was astonished at the awesome transformation of God, how God, Whom heaven and earth cannot contain, is wholly contained in manna and in a particle of bread, with Godhead, Flesh, and Divine Soul; Whom thus confessing, we bow down before the Divine Body of Christ, that we may obtain from Him the Father's blessing.[^22]

items.english_text: Descend, all ye Heavenly Angels, and all ye Powers of God, praise with us God Who became man; Who for the sake of the mercy of mankind, by His unsearchable Divine wisdom, hid Himself in the Mysteries of bread, and left Himself as food for men; Whom as God today festively let us hymn, saying: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, O God, glory to Thy tender compassion!

items.slavonic_text: СЛꙊ́ЖБА [продолженіе съ пред. листа:] є҆го̀, тебѣ́же что̀ сотворю̀ ча́до? речѐ Ѻ҆ц҃ъ къ сн҃Ꙋ своемꙊ̀ І҆са́вꙊ. Стї́хъ. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ и҃. Се́й е́сть хлѣ́бъ соше́дый съ Нб҃се, да а҆́ще кто̀ ѿ него̀ я́стъ жи́въ бꙊ́детъ; возыва́ше І҆и҃съ гла́: а҆́ще кто̀ жа́ждетъ, да прїи́детъ ко мнѣ̀ и҆ пїе́тъ; и҆ рѣ́ки чре́ва є҆го́ и҆стекꙊ́тъ воды̀ жи́вїя; я҆ды́й мою̀ Пло́ть, и҆ пїя́й мою̀ Кро́вь, во мнѣ̀ пребыва́етъ и҆ а҆́зъ в не́мъ. В ПОНЕДѢ́ЛОКЪ НА ОУ҆́ТРЕНИ: НА СТЇХО́ВНАХЪ, Стїхи̑: Гла́съ д҃. Подо́: Я҆́ко до́бля въ мч҃ницехъ: Чл҃вѣколю́бче Сп҃сителю Хрⷭ҇тѐ, сп҃сенїя на́шего ра́ди соше́дый съ Нб҃съ; и҆ ѿ Мр҃їи Дв҃ы вочл҃вѣ́чивыйся, хотя́й во́лею и҆тѝ на сме́рть, сїю̀ Та́инꙊ Бж҃твеннꙊю оу҆ста́вилъ есѝ, дая́и себѐ въ снѣ́дь Оу҆́ченикомъ, и҆ всѣ́мъ вѣ́рнымъ: и҆́мже пода́ждь бл҃гть и҆ живо́тъ вѣ́чный. Стїхъ. И҆ ѡ҆дождѝ и҆̀мъ ма́ннꙊ я́сти, и҆ Хлѣ́бъ Нб҃ный дадѐ и҆̀мъ. А҆́зъ е́смъ хлѣ́бъ нб҃ный, речѐ Гдⷭ҇ь сїѡ́нѡмъ, Оу҆́чникомъ, соше́дый съ Нб҃се: а҆́зъ е́смъ хлѣ́бъ живо́тный, гряды́й ко мнѣ̀ не и҆́матъ вза́лкатися, и҆ вѣ́рꙊяй въ мя̀ не и҆́матъ вжажда́тися; а҆́ще бо кто̀ снѣ́стъ ѿ хлѣ́ба сего̀, жи́въ бꙊ́детъ во вѣ́ки, и҆ хлѣ́бъ є҆го́же а҆́зъ да́мъ, Пло́ть моя̀ е́сть, даю́щая причаща́ющымся живо́тъ вѣ́чный. Стї. Хлѣ́бъ а҆́гглскїй ядѐ чл҃къ, бра́шно посла̀ и҆̀мъ до сы́тїя. Зря́ще та́йнꙊ Пло́ти Бж҃твенныя, хлѣ́бъ Преесте́ственный, Бг҃Ꙋ воплоти́вшемся ѿ Дв҃ы Мр҃їи, со оу҆миле́нїемъ поклони́мся; се́бо е́сть А҆́гнецъ неѕло́бивый, взе́мляй грѣхѝ мі́ра, и҆ сп҃саяй дꙊ́шы на́ша. Сла́: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ в҃. Оу҆диви́ся вся̀ тва́рь Бж҃їемꙊ и҆змѣне́нїю стра́шномꙊ, ка́кѡ Бг҃ъ Нб҃си и҆ землѝ не ѡ҆б̾име́нный, въ ма́ннѣ и҆ части хлѣ́ба, ве́сь содержи́тъся, съ Бж҃твомъ Пло́тїю и҆ дꙊше́ю Бж҃е́ственною, Е҆го́же та́кѡ и҆сповѣ́дꙊюще, Бж҃е́ственномꙊ Тѣ́лꙊ Хв҃Ꙋ покланя́емся: я҆́ко да полꙊчи́мъ ѿ него̀ Ѻ҆́чее бл҃гвенїе. Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Гла́съ то́йже. Прїиди́те вся̀ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇ня, Гдⷭ҇а с на́ми воспо́йте, и҆́же здѣ̀ е́стъ покланя́емый: бл҃гвѣ́те со́лнце мц҃ъ и҆ ѕвѣ́зды; Ѻ҆́гнь, мо́ре, возду́хъ, ѻ҆́блаци и҆ вся̀ тва́рь; я҆́ко ѕѣло̀ и҆ до кон- [продолженіе на слѣд. листѣ]
items.english_text: Come, all ye ends of the earth, let us bless the Most Honorable Body of God: which was broken for us and for our sins, and given unto death upon the Cross, and after the Resurrection ascended into Heaven, seated in glory at the right hand of God the Father, and left upon earth the same unto the faithful in these Mysteries; before which all of us earthborn fall down upon the face of the earth, praising it with compunction.
